entities.name: Andrzej Józwowicz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrzej Józwowicz is a Polish prelate of the Catholic Church who joined the diplomatic service of the Holy See in 1997 and serves as the Apostolic Nuncio to Sri Lanka. An archbishop since 2017, he was Apostolic Nuncio to Rwanda from 2017 to 2021 and Iran from 2021 to 2026.
